description.name: WHMCS-eFactura
description.tagline: RO e-Factura (ANAF) for WHMCS: UBL 2.1 / CIUS-RO invoices sent to the Romanian SPV.
description.long: Sends the fiscal invoices and stornos issued by WHMCS to the Romanian RO e-Factura system (ANAF SPV), tracks their status, archives the signed responses and shows the SPV inbox.
features: UBL 2.1 / CIUS-RO invoices and stornos generated from WHMCS invoices
Upload to ANAF SPV with status tracking and signed archive
Fiscal numbering at payment, with early issue when needed
SPV inbox for received invoices and messages
